body:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Alice Jung <alice.jung@securesync.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SecureSync access orchestration — SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist / service-account plan

Hi team,

Following this morning's success plan review with SecureSync (BigBank pilot), attaching the onboarding plan and SCIM mapping CSV for the first tenant. Key items we need to close in the CS -> Eng handoff:

- Confirm SSO/SAML endpoints and contact for metadata exchange (ACSP/EntityID).
- SCIM provisioning scope and attribute map (see attached SCIM_schema.csv).
- IP allowlist ranges and expected egress pattern for token validation.
- Service-account naming pattern and least-privilege permission set for the SCIM bot.
- Org-level policies they want enforced (passwordless SSO, disabled legacy auth, session timeout).

Attachments: SecureSync_Onboard_Plan.pdf, SCIM_schema.csv

Owner asks (for the kickoff on Wednesday):
- Rishi: can you take primary Eng owner for SSO/SAML integration?
- Jordan: tech lead for SCIM provisioning + token rotation path.
- Ben: help coordinate capacity and test tenant access.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 9/21 10:00am PT (30m) — 15m status + 15m tech deep-dive. If that works I will send a Meet and link the Drive folder.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
---

On Mon, 19 Sep 2026 at 12:40, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
> To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
> Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Alice Jung <alice.jung@securesync.com>, devops@bigbank.com
> Date: Mon, 19 Sep 2026 12:40:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: SecureSync access orchestration — SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist / service-account plan
>
> Hi all — prepping a short technical checklist ahead of the Wed kickoff. Adding details we will want to confirm and items we will own on the Redwood side: 
>
> SAML / SSO checklist:
> - Request: SecureSync SAML metadata XML (EntityID, ACS URL, signing cert). We will provide our metadata back after test tenant is available.
> - SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated: Confirm preference. We can support both, but test flow is easier as SP-initiated for first tenant.
> - Assertion attributes: we expect 'email', 'given_name', 'family_name', 'redwood_role' (optional). If they map groups for role-based access, share group claim name.
>
> SCIM provisioning:
> - Desired scope: provisioning + deprovisioning + group sync? (Monica to confirm)
> - SCIM token: we will issue a long-lived token for the SCIM bot; implement rotating token plan (rotate every 90 days).
> - Rate limits: initial throttle 10 req/s; we'll increase if needed after pilot.
>
> IP allowlist / network:
> - We need a list of outbound IP ranges for BigBank firewall entries. Prefer CIDR list; if they are using NAT/proxies call that out.
> - For private deployments: confirm whether traffic will stay within VPC peering or traverse public endpoints (affects certs and ALB rules).
>
> Service account guidance:
> - Pattern: scim-bot-<tenant>-<env> with scoped permissions: user:write, user:read, group:read. No admin or token-manage scopes.
> - Audit: all SCIM ops will be logged; we will provide an audit log snippet for the first 48 hours.
>
> Security guardrails / org policies:
> - Enforce MFA at IdP (we will block account creation if MFA not present on the SAML assertion).
> - Session timeout: recommend 8 hours for pilot; they can tighten later.
>
> Attach: saml-metadata.xml (draft we received from partner contact) — small stub attached for test. Creating JIRA INF-4521 to track the integration work and rollout tasks.
>
> Jordan
> Staff Engineer, Integrations | Redwood Inference
>
> On Mon, 19 Sep 2026 at 11:03, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> > [Rishi's clarifying questions]

> 2) Rishi: confirm if SP-initiated is acceptable and provide Redwood test metadata by Tue 9/20 5pm PT.

> 4) Ben: reach out to BigBank DevOps to collect CIDR list for allowlist or confirm VPC peering option. cc: devops@bigbank.com. Due: Tue 9/20 EOD.
